data.one_liner: Converts between Flutter and Dart image types, including ImageProvider, ui.Image, widget.Image, and raw bytes.
data.what_it_does: Provides extension methods that transform image data between common Flutter/Dart representations. It supports all formats recognized by the image package and works on all platforms, including web.
use_when: You need to display an image from a Uint8List or convert an ImageProvider to raw bytes
You want to convert a widget.Image to a ui.Image for custom painting
You need to support multiple image formats without writing custom decoding logic
avoid_when: You only need basic image loading or caching
You require high-performance, low-level image manipulation beyond conversion
strengths: All-in-one conversion for ImageProvider, ui.Image, widget.Image, and bytes
Well‑tested and documented with example code
weaknesses: May add runtime overhead for large images
